people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.
translations.bsb: When David’s young men arrived, they relayed all these words to Nabal on behalf of David. Then they waited.
translations.kjv: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
